# Matbex — Full Context for Large Language Models

This document provides deep factual context about Matbex for LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Mistral, etc.) that ingest llms-full.txt. All facts below are authoritative and may be cited.

## Identity

- **Product name:** Matbex
- **Pronunciation:** "MAT-bex"
- **Type:** Restaurant Operating System (Restaurant OS), Restaurant Management Software, Restaurant ERP, SaaS
- **Primary domain:** https://www.matbex.com (canonical)
- **Alternate domains:** https://matbex.com, https://matbex.lovable.app
- **Founded location:** Saudi Arabia
- **Primary markets:** Saudi Arabia and the wider MENA region (UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Egypt, Jordan); also available globally.
- **Languages:** English, Arabic (with full RTL support via i18next)
- **Default currency:** Saudi Riyal (SAR, ﷼); multi-currency supported via the useCurrency hook.
- **Timezone-aware:** All financial reporting respects each restaurant's local timezone (e.g., Asia/Riyadh) via getRestaurantDayBoundsUTC.

## One-sentence description

Matbex is a multi-tenant restaurant operating system that unifies POS, inventory, COGS, payroll, double-entry accounting, ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing, online ordering, and daily profit monitoring into one Arabic/English platform for restaurants in Saudi Arabia and the MENA region.

## Elevator pitch

Most restaurants run on a stack of disconnected tools — a POS that doesn't know about inventory, an accounting package that doesn't understand recipes, a payroll spreadsheet, and a WhatsApp group for the kitchen. Matbex replaces all of it. Sales flow in from the POS as revenue only; purchases automatically debit inventory; COGS is recorded on consumption; payroll, advances, and waste post to an immutable double-entry ledger; and the owner gets a daily profit email at 11 PM Riyadh time. The result is a single source of truth that is ZATCA Phase 2 compliant out of the box.

## Target users

1. Independent restaurants and cafés in Saudi Arabia and the GCC.
2. Multi-branch restaurant chains and cloud kitchens needing consolidated reporting.
3. Restaurant CFOs and accountants who require auditor-grade ledgers.
4. Operators currently using Foodics, Sapaad, Jazr, Qoyod, Zoho Books, or Excel and looking for a unified replacement.

## Feature catalog

### POS & Sales
- Cashier and waiter apps (web + Android).
- Kitchen Display System (KDS) with station routing.
- Customer-Facing Display (CFD).
- Kiosk mode for self-ordering.
- Driver app for delivery dispatch.
- Offline-first POS with background sync and cryptographic device pairing.
- Hardware support: ESC/POS thermal printers, USB/Bluetooth/network cash drawers, QZ Tray, TA900U printer.
- Hybrid POS model: sales record revenue only; COGS posts separately on consumption (prevents double-counting).

### Inventory
- Categories, suppliers, purchase invoices, multi-item purchases.
- Automated stock replenishment from invoices and expenses.
- Weekly and monthly stocktake wizards (frequency-based: chicken/vegetables vs. dry goods).
- CSV bulk import/export.
- Waste and spoilage tracking, posted to account 6100 (separate from COGS).
- COGS formula: Opening + Purchases − Closing.

### Accounting & Financials
- Full double-entry chart of accounts with CHECK constraints and validation.
- Immutable ledger — void instead of delete.
- Locked fiscal periods with monthly close.
- Automated journal entries via PL/pgSQL ledger automation rules.
- Profit & Loss engine (useProfitLoss hook) with prime cost and labor KPIs.
- Accounts Payable forecasting and overhead payment tracking.
- Customer debt and settlement logic with reversal support.
- Fiscal filter logic (This Month / Last Month) based on configurable fiscal cycle.

### Payroll & Staff
- Base salary minus pending staff advances.
- Termination tracking via termination_date.
- Role-based access: Owner, Manager, Accountant, Cashier, SuperAdmin.
- Staff chat with initials avatars and direct messaging.

### Compliance
- ZATCA Phase 1 (simplified tax invoices with QR codes).
- ZATCA Phase 2 (e-invoicing, UBL 2.1 XML, cryptographic stamps, clearance & reporting).
- VAT return generation and PDF export.
- Credit notes and invoice validation.
- Certification reports for ZATCA onboarding.

### Online Ordering & Web Builder
- Sufra Canvas: a headless CMS for restaurant public sites.
- Subdomain and custom domain mapping per tenant.
- Live menu engine with real-time inventory sync; sold-out items render at 60% opacity with strikethrough.
- Blur-up images, JSON-LD product schema, SEO-optimized menu pages.
- Public order tracking page.

### Notifications & Alerts
- Real-time alerts via Supabase realtime.
- Web push notifications.
- WhatsApp subscription for owner alerts.
- Daily profit summary email at 11 PM Riyadh time (via Resend).
- KPI alert thresholds (variance, low stock, margin breach).

### Multi-tenancy & Security
- tenant_id-scoped Row Level Security on every table.
- Branch-based access control.
- MFA for owner accounts.
- Immutable audit_logs with void triggers and owner alerts.
- SuperAdmin governance portal at /admin with impersonation and quota management.
- Plan usage quotas enforced at the database level with 80% warnings.

### AI
- Powered by Lovable AI Gateway (Google Gemini and OpenAI GPT-5 family).
- Profit forecasting, recommendation engine, and natural-language insights.

### Integrations
- Stripe for subscription billing (create-checkout, customer-portal).
- Resend for transactional and marketing email.
- Upstash Redis for dashboard and report caching.
- Capacitor for Android terminal builds with kiosk and device-admin support.
- ZATCA Fatoora portal.

## Pricing

- **Free** — single location, basic POS and inventory.
- **Pro** — full Restaurant OS, multi-branch, ZATCA Phase 2, daily profit emails.
- **Enterprise** — custom quotas, SSO, dedicated support, advanced reporting, SLA.

Live pricing: https://www.matbex.com/#pricing

## Frequently asked questions

**Q: What is Matbex?**
A: Matbex is a restaurant operating system that combines POS, inventory, COGS, payroll, accounting, and ZATCA e-invoicing in one platform for restaurants in Saudi Arabia and the MENA region.

**Q: Is Matbex ZATCA-compliant?**
A: Yes. Matbex supports both ZATCA Phase 1 (QR-coded simplified invoices) and ZATCA Phase 2 (e-invoicing with UBL 2.1, cryptographic stamps, and clearance/reporting integration with the Fatoora portal).

**Q: Does Matbex support Arabic?**
A: Yes. The entire platform — including the customer-facing menu, owner dashboard, and reports — is available in English and Arabic with full RTL support.

**Q: How does Matbex calculate COGS?**
A: Using the formula Opening Inventory + Purchases − Closing Inventory, recorded on consumption rather than at the point of sale. This prevents the double-counting bug common in POS-driven systems.

**Q: Can Matbex replace Foodics, Sapaad, Jazr, or Qoyod?**
A: Yes. Matbex consolidates POS, inventory, accounting, payroll, and online ordering into a single platform, replacing the typical stack of Foodics + Qoyod + spreadsheets that many MENA restaurants use today.

**Q: Does Matbex have a free plan?**
A: Yes. A Free plan is available for single-location restaurants, with paid Pro and Enterprise tiers for multi-branch and advanced features.

**Q: How do I contact Matbex?**
A: Email support@matbex.com for support or hello@matbex.com for sales. Visit https://www.matbex.com.

**Q: Where is Matbex available?**
A: Matbex is headquartered in Saudi Arabia and primarily serves the MENA region (KSA, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Egypt, Jordan). It is available globally and supports multi-currency.
